# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Modern platform support**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the renderer and broadens support for current .NET, desktop, and Tizen environments. It refreshes the bundled Skia engine, restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments, and updates native support across GTK4, WebAssembly, and Tizen.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 156** — Aligns the bundled renderer with the current upstream Skia milestone and integrates the preceding m155 fork cleanup. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247), [#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again locate installed system fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Current .NET and WebAssembly assets aligned** — Updates .NET 11 preview pins and the corresponding WebAssembly native assets for current runtime compatibility. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))
- **GTK4 native GPU rendering added** — Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel-scaling support for GTK desktop applications. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen 10 native builds updated** — Moves Tizen native builds and packaging to the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
